title: Vans Electroengineerings IPO Details
intro:
Vans Electroengineerings IPO is a book build issue of ₹33.98 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 28.80 lakh shares of ₹33.98 crore.

Vans Electroengineerings IPO opens for subscription on Sep 29, 2026 and closes on Oct 1, 2026. The allotment for the Vans Electroengineerings IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 5, 2026. Vans Electroengineerings IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 7, 2026.

Vans Electroengineerings IPO is set issue price band at ₹112 to ₹118 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,83,200 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹4,24,800.

Hem Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Hem Finlease Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Vans Electroengineerings IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in February 2022, VANS Electroengineerings Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and supply of components used in traction power supply and overhead equipment systems for Indian railway electrification infrastructure, metro systems and renewable energy applications. Its products are primarily supplied to Indian Railways and railway contractors, and the Company operates from its registered office and manufacturing facility in Salem, Tamil Nadu.

The Company manufactures Single Pole and Double Pole Vacuum Circuit Breakers (VCBs) and Vacuum Interrupters (VIs) for applications including traction substations, sectioning posts, feeding posts and other railway electrification systems. Its product portfolio includes products approved by the Research Designs and Standards Organization (RDSO), and the Company has received approvals from the Central Organization for Railway Electrification (CORE), including “Approved Vendor” status for certain products.

The Company’s manufacturing facility is equipped with machinery including busbar multi-processing and horizontal bandsaw machines, along with in-house testing and quality control infrastructure. It also engages with the Korea Electrotechnology Research Institute (KERI), South Korea and Central Power Research Institute (CPRI), Bengaluru for product testing and compliance with standards including IEC 62505-1:2016 and IEC 62271-100/2017-07. These capabilities support the development and supply of products for railway, metro, industrial and special applications.

The Company is supported by promoters and management with experience across electrical and electronics engineering, railway infrastructure, switchgear manufacturing and industrial manufacturing. Its operations are focused on product development, engineering, manufacturing, quality control, sales and supply chain management.
As of August 31, 2026, the Company had 33 employees across manufacturing, product development, quality control, finance and accounting, administration and operations, and purchase and stores.

faqs.question: How to apply in Vans Electroengineerings IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Vans Electroengineerings IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Vans Electroengineerings IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Vans Electroengineerings IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Vans Electroengineerings IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Vans Electroengineerings IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
